commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 (PR #1300): removes hard-coded exemplar entry_is_line_a..e derived rules (proof atoms citing other chapters' HTS lines) from every generated chapter and makes them caller inputs; summary claims runtime semantics unchanged — unsure, part of the same decoupling repair.
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs, and gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The chapter 56 composition hard-coded five alien HTS line numbers as the only qualifying entries for its action components, a condition set traceable to the witness exemplars rather than to chapter 56's cited source.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 48. Diff read in full; no additional substantive change.
triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this as a mechanical decoupling and could not: the ch49 diff deletes five `derived` rules whose formulas were hard identity tests against other chapters' statistical reporting numbers (7202.11.10.00, 7601.10.30.00, 9506.62.40.40, 2203.00.00.30, 8541.42.00.10), and the identifiers remain referenced at 14 sites in the post file (lines 1906, 1923, 2366, 2522, 2571, 2647, 2691, 2743, 2750, 2815, 2871, 2993-2997, 3038, 3196) with no `inputs:` block, so under the module's own stated "referenced-implies-input convention" they become caller-supplied and every gated branch changes value. The pre-state conditions were unsatisfiable inside this module: the ch49 line table holds only 49xx keys and `schedule_base_general_rate` raises on a missing key, so a chapter 49 entry's `hts_number` can never equal a chapter 22/72/76/85/95 line — and the module's `source_verification` citation list contains no chapter 49 provision at all, only the five foreign exemplar lines plus chapter 99 overlays. That is exactly "a condition with no basis in the cited source / grounded on the wrong provision," and the fix removes it; the hand-built witness at us/policies/cbp/us-tariff-duty/composition.yaml keeps the five flags (line 691), confirming they were legitimate only for the five-line oracle and were wrongly copied into 100 generated chapters.
triage.verifier_notes: inferred from verified sibling module index 48 (same kind and rule path in this chunk). Three caveats for the reviewer, none of which overturn the verdict. (1) The first reader's quote is from the PR body and describes more than this commit: the membership-semantic re-gating of `section_122_component_rate` and the new `section_232_steel_component_rate` are NOT in the ch49 diff for 2a6bdb01de — this commit is only the removal half (subject: "b1.6: make generated entry flags caller inputs"). The kind still holds on this commit's own content. (2) The reader's reading ("every component gated on them ... could never fire") is directionally imprecise: several gates put the flags in negative/carve-out position — `if entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b: 0 else: ...` (lines 2571/3038/3196 post) and `if origin_is_brazil and not entry_is_line_b: brazil_ieepa_additional_duty_rate else: 0` — so with the flags permanently false the exemptions never fired and the duty always applied, while the §301 stack (post lines 2993-2997) was identically 0. Wrong in both directions, untraceable in all. (3) The sharpest single instance is `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded`, whose declared source is "Chapter 99 U.S. note reciprocal annex exclusion list under heading 9903.01.32" but whose formula is `entry_is_line_a` — i.e. pre-fix, "excluded from the reciprocal tariff iff the entry is ferromanganese." The strongest not_a_defect argument (generated chapters are declared deterministic copies of the witness pilot surface, so the flags are scaffolding rather than a chapter 49 claim) fails because the module still emits chapter-49 §301/§232/§338/reciprocal-exclusion component outputs whose values those flags decided, and the maintainers themselves call the pre-state unlawful in the PR body ("the witness's exemplar coupling, which round-2 evaluation showed unlawfully suppressed the surcharge on §301-member lines for all origins"). The runner-up kind is wrong_entity_or_scope (the flags scope the ch49 stack to five foreign-chapter lines); untraceable_branch fits better because the fix removes the conditions and their proof atoms cite provisions outside the module's subject chapter. The summary's boilerplate "changes no formula tokens, dates, inputs, proof atoms, or runtime values" is about the redundant-parenthesis placement-gate serialization (identical in pre and post) and cannot cover a five-rule deletion; the PR comment "companion tests now feed only the retained exemplar flags (a/b/d) — c and e are fully replaced and no longer valid input slots" independently confirms the input-surface change.
